references.text: The angel instructs Samson's mother to abstain from wine and strong drink, as her son is to be a Nazirite from birth.
Samson is to be a Nazirite of God from his mother's womb, so she must follow the Nazirite rules.
Samson's mother is commanded not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine, or to drink wine or strong drink.
Aaron and his sons are forbidden to drink wine or strong drink when they enter the tent of meeting.
Israel is criticized for giving wine to the Nazirites to drink, which broke their vow.
John the Baptist is not to drink wine or strong drink, similar to the abstinence of the Nazirites.
Kings are warned against drinking wine and strong drink, so that they do not forget the law.
The Rechabites abstained from wine by command of their ancestor Jonadab, an example of self-restraint.
